project_adaptation.scope: Frozen research specification only; not installed in signal generation or execution
project_adaptation.opening_range: 09:15 inclusive to 09:45 exclusive; require six complete valid 5-minute bars
project_adaptation.signal: First completed bar closing above range high or below range low, after the opening range; compare with preceding close to require a crossing
project_adaptation.entry_window: Signal must be known strictly before 11:30; one trade per session, no re-entry
project_adaptation.entry: Earliest observable executable quote after the signal; never fill at the completed signal bar price
project_adaptation.direction: CE for upside, PE for downside
project_adaptation.contract: ATM listed strike at signal time; nearest listed expiry at least two calendar days away; bind exact contract until exit
project_adaptation.exits: Underlying crossing opposite range boundary, underlying reaching entry spot plus/minus two opening-range widths, or 15:10 time exit, whichever is observed first
project_adaptation.quote_requirements: Actual exchange-timestamped uncrossed bid/ask with displayed quantity, quote age at most 10 seconds; buy at ask and sell at bid plus separately stated costs; missing exit path means unpriceable, never zero P&L
project_adaptation.sizing: Research comparison uses one historically valid contract lot; reject if full premium plus modeled charges exceeds INR 5000 on INR 500000 capital. Do not resize to reach income target.
project_adaptation.parameter_search: None for this specification; every later change is a new counted experiment
project_adaptation.evidence: Historical exploration only. Previously examined dates cannot become untouched confirmation data.
project_adaptation.monthly_probability: Not estimable until actual option outcomes and sufficient chronological months are available
